non_blocking_notes: Patch is narrow, focused, and deterministic. Stage composition preserves exact ordering and tenant/source bindings through frozen immutable dataclasses. All four lifecycle stages transition correctly with no authority or deployment capability. Mission Control projection validation is comprehensive: tenant_id/event_id consistency enforced across all stages, secret-bearing and cross-tenant input rejected, mode/kill_switch/deployment locked to safe defaults. Tests cover happy path (CRITICAL risk trigger), gating (MEDIUM risk stops before proposal), cross-tenant rejection, secret rejection, and DEMO labeling. No executor functions or feed/registry/build/publish/deploy capabilities added.
result.reasoning_summary: FW-SUPPLY-006 acceptance criteria fully satisfied. The integrated lifecycle function composes the four normalized/classified/bound/proposed stages in deterministic order, preserving tenant/source bindings through immutable frozen dataclasses. Lower-risk indicators (MEDIUM) correctly fail before proposal stage. Mission Control projection exposes only sanitized, read-only canonical or DEMO-labeled facts with comprehensive validation: rejects secret-bearing values, cross-tenant binding, tampered event_ids, and all operating modes locked (DRY_RUN/DISABLED/ENGAGED). No authority_granted or response_executed capabilities present. No executor functions for deployment, remediation, or response are added. Test coverage is deterministic and focused: stage ordering, risk-based gating, immutability, cross-tenant rejection, secret rejection, and DEMO labeling. Patch scope is narrow and safely isolated to composition and read-only projection only.
